notes.content: [p][color=#FF7378]Bugfixes:[/color][/p][list][*][p]Starting a custom level multiple times at once no longer crashes the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some regressions regarding animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some regressions regarding fonts.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some regressions regarding music and sounds.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Update 0.8.4 - Bugfixes
notes.content: [p][color=#FF7378]Bugfixes:[/color][/p][list][*][p]Encountering an illegal state now aborts the current move, which should prevent some of the crazier movement bugs.[/p][/*][*][p]Level editor: Wall and environment tiles are reset correctly again.[/p][/*][*][p]Level editor: Decoration tiles are saved correctly again.[/p][/*][*][p]Added missing background in level 3.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed wall type in level 9.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Update 0.8.3 - Quality of Life
notes.content: [p]\[color=#3cba59]New Features:\[/color][/p][list][*][p]Added option to toggle grid.[/p][/*][*][p]Added option to speed up teleport animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Added custom levels search bar.[/p][/*][*][p]Added button to copy custom levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Level editor: Starting abilities are now possible by stacking Fruits on top of Tricula.[/p][/*][*][p]Level editor: zoom in and out with mouse wheel or +/- buttons.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]\[color=#41b6ea]Changes:\[/color][/p][list][*][p]Upgraded Godot version from 3.5 to 4.4.[/p][/*][*][p]Import / export functionality now uses native file dialogs.[/p][/*][*][p]Level editor: Creating / deleting tiles is now continuous.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced maximum length of Teleportal names to 3.[/p][/*][*][p]Added twinkle animation to background stars.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]\[color=#FF7378]Bugfixes:\[/color][/p][list][*][p]Level editor: mirror tiles surrounded by mirror tiles will no longer vanish.[/p][/*][*][p]Tiny coffins now also block mirrors.[/p][/*][*][p]Belts no longer split when teleporting.[/p][/*][*][p]Tall pillars no longer refuse to connect when one part is flipped.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed Teleportal name from level 22.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 0.8.2 - Portals and Bugfixes
notes.content:
[color=#3cba59]New Features:[/color]
    - Level editor: added Teleportals and Telefruit.
	- Level editor: added Anchor block to explicitly define level borders.
	- Level editor: added common shortcuts for undo/redo and saving.

[color=#41b6ea]Changes:[/color]
	- Tall and big pillars can now be partially destroyed by spike balls.
	- Level editor: tall and big pillars can now be partially deleted or moved.
	- Level editor: moving the mouse to the edge of the screen will no longer move the screen. Instead, the "Move" tool may be used.
	- The custom level selection screen now remembers the scroll position while the game is running.
	- Double-clicking on a custom level now plays the level instead of opening the level editor.
	- Moved "Back" buttons to give menus more space.

[color=#FF7378]Bugfixes:[/color]
    - Added missing mirror sprites.
	- Filled holes in the level border.
	- Belts can no longer be split.
	- Levels will now be considered completed whenever all coffins are filled and no playable entities remain.
	- Leftwards rolling entities no longer move when also shifted to the right.
	- Held entities no longer start rolling when pushed.
	- Entities no longer die by mirror when the mirror is blocked by another entity.
	- Unlocking a coffin twice under water will no longer crash the game.
	- Arms failing to pull another entity beneath them will no longer lift themselves up anyway.
	- Level editor: holdable tiny coffins now keep their handles after saving.
	- Restarting a level after undoing no longer leads to a negative move count.
	- The "Wait" button is no longer greyed out when entities are being teleported.
	- The "Wait" button is now greyed out when no entities are moving, even if they are rolling.
	- The level editor now ignores inputs while a level is being tested.
	- Cloud blocks are now correctly named "Cloud" in the interaction menu.
	- The overworld star count now includes red stars, but excludes custom levels.
	- Level editor: entities at the bottom of the level no longer appear to be falling.
	- Level editor: the "Move" and "Delete" tools are no longer displaced or show coffin handles when certain entities are selected.

notes.title: Update 0.8.1 - Bugfixes
notes.content:
[color=#FF7378]Bugfixes:[/color]
    - Certain screen resolutions no longer cause a gray screen.
    - Undoing the creation of entities in the level editor will now be saved correctly.

notes.title: Update 0.8.0 - The level editor is here!
notes.content:
[color=#3cba59]New Features:[/color]
    - Added level editor.
	- Added offline import / export functionality for custom levels.
	- Added cloud block.

[color=#41b6ea]Changes:[/color]
    - Updated the handle sprite for small and tiny coffins.
    
[color=#FF7378]Bugfixes:[/color]
    - Belts now stay connected.
	- Belts now always shift entities in the correct direction.

notes.title: Patch 0.6.2
notes.content:
[color=#41b6ea]Changes:[/color]
    - Added playtesters section to the credits.
    
[color=#FF7378]Bugfixes:[/color]
    - The game icon should be back.
    - Coffin still sometimes unlocked after teleport. Should be fixed now.
    - Undo button is no longer greyed out after first move.

notes.title: Patch 0.6.1
notes.content:
[color=#41b6ea]Changes:[/color]
    - Added a coin to level 28 ("Pool day").
    - It is now possible to jump over rolling balls.
	- Added changelog.

[color=#FF7378]Bugfixes:[/color]
    - Spikeball no longer rolls in wrong direction after being pushed.
    - Coffin no longer unlocks after teleport.
    - It is no longer possible to jump while standing on a connected falling entity. 
    - Entities can no longer be pushed into other entities.
    - Double-clicking on "Back to Map" no longer crashes the game.
    - Entities that are standing on both moving and unmoving ground will no longer be moved along.
    - Fixed several issues with undo.
    - Held entities can now also be shifted.
    - Fixed several visual issues.
